title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Distributed Platforms)
description: Build robust, customer-facing web applications with high-throughput backend services, reactive UI components, and enterprise-grade data security.

required_skills.description: Clean microservices, async workflows, idempotency and modular design.
Node.js/Express/Go endpoints, validation, error handling, rate limiting.
PostgreSQL/MySQL indexing, transactions, ACID guarantees, query plan tuning.
React state management, SSR/CSR trade-offs, hooks, performance profiling.
Cache invalidation strategies, write-through vs read-through, session stores.
RBAC, CSRF/XSS mitigation, secure cookies, token expiration.
Docker containers, automated test suites, deployment pipelines.

title: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer
description: Design fault-tolerant distributed backends handling 50k+ QPS with p99 latencies under 20ms, robust consensus, and partitioned data stores.

required_skills.description: High-scale distributed systems, event-driven patterns, CAP theorem tradeoffs.
gRPC/REST concurrency, backpressure, circuit breakers, dead-letter queues.
Partitioning, sharding, replication lags, WAL, write-heavy optimizations.
Distributed caching, cache stamps, Lua scripts, pub-sub clusters.
Thread pools, non-blocking I/O, race condition mitigation, lock contention.
Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), p99 metric alerts, Prometheus/Grafana.

title: Lead Frontend Architect
description: Own the UI/UX architecture for high-velocity real-time dashboards, WebSockets streams, canvas visualizations, and micro-frontend integrations.

required_skills.description: Advanced component architecture, custom hook composition, server components.
Bundle chunking, memoization, INP/LCP/CLS optimization, virtualized lists.
Zustand/Redux/Jotai, WebSocket sync, optimistic UI updates, conflict resolution.
Tailwind, CSS architecture, accessible design tokens, micro-interactions.
Vitest, Playwright E2E, mock service workers, snapshot resilience.
Client-side XSS sanitization, CSP headers, credential storage.

title: Senior AI/ML Platform & Agentic Engineer
description: Build autonomous multi-agent pipelines, RAG vector retrieval backends, prompt optimization loops, and production LLM evaluation guardrails.

required_skills.description: State machines, tool-calling loops, multi-agent consensus, plan-execute cycles.
Vector databases (Pinecone/Milvus/Qdrant), hybrid search, re-ranking, embeddings.
Hallucination detection, rubric grading, latency budgets, structured outputs.
Streaming SSE/WebSocket endpoints, prompt caching, token cost optimization.
Asynchronous worker queues, batch inference, rate-limit management.
Document chunking strategies, semantic indexing, metadata enrichment.

title: Senior Cloud & Platform DevOps Engineer
description: Scale Kubernetes clusters, build zero-downtime deployment pipelines, enforce infrastructure-as-code, and establish self-healing cloud topologies.

required_skills.description: K8s ingress, HPA autoscaling, Helm charts, sidecar patterns, networking.
State locking, reusable modules, multi-region failover configurations.
GitOps (ArgoCD), canary deployments, automated rollbacks, security scanning.
SLO/SLA definition, Prometheus metrics, distributed tracing, incident triage.
Cloud IAM policies, secrets management (Vault), zero-trust architecture.
VPC peering, load balancers, CDN edge caching, egress cost optimization.

title: Lead Data Systems & Pipeline Architect
description: Architect petabyte-scale data lakes and warehouses with real-time streaming ingestion, dbt transformations, and high-fidelity data contracts.

required_skills.description: BigQuery / Snowflake clustering, partitioning, storage tiering, query cost cuts.
Star/snowflake schema, dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
Kafka / PubSub, Apache Flink / Spark, idempotency, exactly-once delivery.
FastAPI/Express data APIs, webhook ingesters, schema validation.
End-to-end data pipelines, backpressure management, disaster recovery.
Data quality checks (Great Expectations), pipeline alerting, schema drift alerts.
